about_the_game:
"Narial is the most authentic and the most mystical along the cities in the realms. It was really a mystery that how did this small city survived the great wars. Some say it was just mere luck that it survived but, some say otherwise."

Contents

New puzzle series for Mirror Atelier await you in Cloud Machina: Skyships Of Narial! This mysterious city is home to the two most wondrous skyships of the Overcloud. Cloud Machina is a world of its own and holds thrilling stories of mystic secrets that are yours to uncover behind the walls of Narial.

Fable

This fable tells the story of a group of youngsters from the Cloud City Narial chasing legends. Some say they're just rumors or trade tricks to lure the visitors to the city. But Lulu thinks that there are more than meets the eye to these stories. Join her and her friends in their adventure to uncover the biggest secret of Narial.

World

Cloud Machina is a world of steampunk pseudo-science. It is a realm of dreams above the clouds where kind, soft white clouds can turn into a dark, chaotic storm at any moment. Enjoyable new puzzles and stories are awaiting you.

Features

  • The "Skyships of Narial" fable includes 3 series of 7 levels each, with every level containing 2 or 3 stages to solve.
  • A 5,000-word narrative filled with adventure, mystery, thrill and more.
  • Discover the stunning visuals of a mysterious medieval town across every puzzle stage.
  • Uncover the captivating story piece by piece as you complete each stage.
  • Enjoy new musics which are specific for this serie.
